people.name: Capernaum
people.line: Town in Galilee; center of Jesus' ministry

translations.web: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
translations.bsb: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades!
translations.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
translations.asv: And thou, Capernaum, shalt thou be exalted unto heaven? thou shalt be brought down unto Hades.
